caseName: National Ass'n for the Advancement of Colored People, Inc. v. Daniel
caseNameFull: National Association for the Advancement of Colored People, Inc. v. Daniel
judges: Appellants, Appendix, Blackmun, Copies, File, Grant, Motion, Require, Stevens

opinions.text:
Motion of appellants to file an appendix to a jurisdictional statement that does not comply with the Rules of this Court denied.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, and Justice O’Connor would grant the motion and require the appellants to file 40 copies of the appendix.
